title: Ending-of-phrase vibrato and trombone slide vibrato
summary: They discuss cracking vibrato at the end of phrases, clarinet and cornet vibrato, and how trombonists like Jim Robinson and Louis Nelson use lip and slide.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Lips, teeth and breath: the physical craft of brass playing
